name: SafeOrStolen
description: A stolen-item verification hub. Depending on the item, checks search law-enforcement stolen-vehicle and stolen-gun records, federal VIN and recall records, a national stolen-bicycle registry, the lost and stolen phone blacklist (paid phone checks), SafeOrStolen's own reports, and public web results. AI notes are advisory only.

additionalSources.vehicles: Arizona law-enforcement stolen-vehicle records; federal VIN and recall records
additionalSources.phones: lost and stolen phone blacklist (paid check)

notChecked: police databases outside Arizona (vehicles) and Ohio (firearms)
